findings.title: After a stack- or adapter-only release, init and the stash-cli skill steer users and agents to downgrade @cipherstash/stack
findings.label: match
findings.note: Stack-only releases leave stash's embed stale, and the direction-less skew check then steers users and agents to downgrade, which is exactly KD-1.

findings.title: An embedded version missing from npm breaks init installs and `stash wizard` for that CLI release
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same unpublished-pin risk: tsup embeds manifest versions and pinnedSpec/wizard spawn have no fallback, so a partial publish breaks installs.
